claims.symptoms: migraine without aura (MO) in women aged 19-34 years had borderline higher CRP; women aged 60-81 years with MO had significantly lower CRP
claims.supporting_quote: In women, CRP levels were borderline higher in those with MO compared with non-migraineurs and those with MA (1.01 mg/l vs. 0.81 and 0.75 mg/l, P = 0.08 and P = 0.08) in age group 19-34 years, but significantly lower in age group 60-81 years (0.52 mg/l vs. 1.07 and 1.01 mg/l, P = 0.007 and P = 0.03).
